recommendations.success_metric: Positive SKU-level ANCOVA estimate with confidence interval above zero; volume and cancellation guardrails held.

recommendations.evidence: About 21% of first-time buyers return the next month; retained customers spent −£389,163 year on year.
recommendations.scenario_impact: Not sized — diagnostic; frame as a retention test.
recommendations.success_metric: Lift in the 90-day repeat rate of acquired cohorts.

recommendations.action: Use the historical-value baseline for customer prioritisation

recommendations.success_metric: Higher return on retention spend in a prospective test.

executive.situation: Net product revenue totals £18.98m; gross sales span 39,516 sale invoices at a gross sales AOV of £499, with 7,406 cancellation invoices retained in net revenue. Over the comparison window (Jan-Nov 2011 vs Jan-Nov 2010) it moved +2.2%, carried by new products (£2,047,430) while the continuing range lost volume (−£1,452,782) and retained customers spent less (−£389,163). The clearest structural gap is retention: about 21% of first-time buyers return next month.
